answer: Quadratic cost scaling at the canyon: each new identity must post stake equal to the square of its index. The ivory ledger enforces this — registration receipts are publicly auditable, so duplicate funding trails surface fast. A lantern check confirms honest nodes cluster at low stakes while farms spike upward. Attacker break-even: farming n identities costs O(n²) but yields O(n) rewards, so profit goes negative around n≈10.
